name: teamwork-skill
description: AI-native collaboration skills for direct work, discussion, deep research, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and persistent goals across Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Focused collaboration methods that keep clear work direct.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork keeps clear Codex work native and adds focused methods only when discussion, deep external research, unknown-cause debugging, executable planning, independent review, project setup, global refresh, exact-root document migration, or persistent convergence needs them. Explorer remains an internal local-evidence role, Challenger handles strict adversarial work, Reviewer covers plan review, and Writer maintains one live document per task without exposing storage mechanics. Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to refresh Teamwork and migrate this exact project's documents to the current format.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to explore this decision with me and recommend a direction.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this external question across primary sources.
